name: model.addSchema
claim: Human can propose a schema addition, but queue append is not admission.

name: model.addField
claim: Human can propose a field addition against a selected model target.

name: model.addEdge
claim: Human can confirm a semantic relation candidate for later validation/admission.

name: model.deprecateField
claim: Human can mark a field deprecation intent without mutating accepted ledger.

name: model.addProjection
claim: Human can confirm a projection modeling intent.

name: model.changeLodRule
claim: Human can confirm a LOD rule change as modeling intent.

name: agent.inspect
claim: Human can ask an agent to inspect a target before model commit.

name: agent.proposeModel
claim: Agent may produce modelingProposal.v1, never accepted ledger changes.

name: agent.fixProjection
claim: Agent may propose projection fixes with evidence and tests.

name: agent.addTest
claim: Agent may add tests to protect a modeling or projection boundary.

name: agent.explainEdge
claim: Agent may explain edge evidence without committing the model.

name: agent.findEvidence
claim: Agent may find evidence before a human confirms model commit.
